ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Innovative Money Matters Private Limited, an existing promoter of Avonmore Capital & Management Services Limited, has disclosed a minor open market acquisition of 36,892 shares, representing a 0.01% increase in its stake. This transaction raises the promoter's total holding from 33.63% to 33.64%, serving as a routine regulatory filing under SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares & Takeovers Regulations. The negligible percentage change indicates no material impact on control or financial position, and there are no apparent red flags associated with this standard disclosure.
